format: Input field definitions only. No participant instances, estimates, or result tables are included.
file_format: NPZ arrays with allow_pickle=False, numeric or Unicode/bytes string arrays, no object dtype. Local files outside candidate.

feature_packet.P: N x D finite floats; MEG D=24480, EEG D=9920
feature_packet.I: N x D finite floats, exactly matching original pair rows in P
feature_packet.y: N integers: MEG physical label 0/1; EEG flower/penguin/guitar 0/1/2
feature_packet.original_uid: N unique original-pair strings, frozen order, globally unique across source/target
feature_packet.owner: N strings giving original person membership, no alternate relabeling

EEG_extra.P_onset_sample: N native integer sample indices at 1024Hz

MEG_target_extra.onset_log_sec: N finite floating-point original behavior log onset seconds used by actual donor and correspondence producers

feature_packet.ordering: Source rows grouped in frozen person order; EEG people sorted. Target EEG has all person sessions, sorted frozen session order then original pair order. Do not reorder from outcomes.

assignment_packet.labels: 200 x N int, first row true, remaining 199 frozen draws
assignment_packet.donor: 200 x N nonself row index with same supervision label
assignment_packet.original_uid: exact equality and order with feature packet
assignment_packet.MEG_manipulation_evaluation_labels: 200 x N; first row 1-labels[0], remaining rows labels[1:]
assignment_packet.EEG_rules: seed PCG64 SeedSequence([20261032, numeric public ID]); balanced person/session/truecategory codes; all realized donors within session; original fixed draw order
assignment_packet.MEG_rules: Recall PCG64 seed20261019; manipulation PCG64 seed20261029; one stream across frozen target order, not independently reset per person. Same fixed draws across representations and source deletions.

source_model: Produced by fit-source; scaler/PCA/B4 arrays plus source_ids, source_original_uids, modality. Never construct from fitted target information.

EEG_whole_person_inference.primary_fraction: shape [12], main source11 result per target
EEG_whole_person_inference.outer_delete_fraction: shape [12,12], row deleted person, column target; NaN diagonal, finite off-diagonal full source10 refits; not PP units

MEG_correspondence_API.timing_for_mismatch: Original log onset seconds as floating-point costs; retain historical units and tie ordering

source_data/EXTERNAL_PRIMARY_PERSON_ESTI.rows: one row per target person, shape required by fixed plot

FINAL_SCIENTIFIC_RESULTS_AUDIT.json or q.meaning: Independently audited matching outcomes, not an invented PASS marker

D1_people[person].P,I,MI: [N,306,20] historical 100ms mean time bins (MI may have different N)
D1_people[person].y,my: physical binary label arrays; manipulation intended=1-my
D1_people[person].uids,muids: original-trial identifiers aligned to each task
D1_people[person].cal,src,test: frozen integer index arrays; source320 balanced originals from10 eligible sources

historical_dictionary_inputs.D6_people[person]: D1 dictionary plus pool indices; counts10/20, calibration2/4 per class, disjoint pool vs paired test; original selection from historical core retained
historical_dictionary_inputs.listener_origin_people[person]: Task dicts IMAGERY_RECALL and IMAGERY_MANIPULATION with P,I,y,uid; available[task], test[task], cal indices. budget object has check() and fits counter.
